title: Notice Bands on a Car Rental Given Up
content:
The notice a supplier is given when a Car Rental Rate Classes rental is given up sets the share of the
basis that is withheld. The whole days of notice are the calendar days from the date the renter gave the
rental up to the date of the scheduled collection.

| Whole days of notice between the rental being given up and the scheduled collection | Share of the basis |
| --- | --- |
| 14 or more | 20 per cent |
| 3 to 13 | 45 per cent |

Where fourteen or more whole days of notice were given between the rental being given up and the scheduled
collection the share is 20 per cent. Where three to thirteen whole days of notice were given between the
rental being given up and the scheduled collection the share is 45 per cent. For a rental given up with
fewer than 3 whole days of notice, no band under this head applies to it.

## Where each band begins and ends

- 14 whole days of notice falls in the first band and the share is 20 per cent; 13 whole days falls in the
  second and the share is 45 per cent.
- 3 whole days of notice still falls in the second band and the share is 45 per cent; 2 whole days falls
  under neither band.

## Counting the days

The count runs from the date the rental was given up to the date of the scheduled collection, in calendar
days, and both dates are dates rather than moments: a rental given up in the evening and collected in the
morning 14 days later has 14 whole days of notice.
